privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data Xafari collects, what it is used for, where it is stored and how you can exercise your rights, under Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).

sections.title: Data we collect
items: When you sign up: first name, last name, email, password, date of birth and the house (hotel) where you are staying.
If you add them to your profile: pronouns or gender and reservation number.
While you play: your avatar, the activities you complete (xecrets, Xperiences, Xelfies and checklist), your ratings and, if you join one, your in-game family.
The camera is only used to read QR codes on your phone; we do not store or send images.

sections.title: Minors
items: If you are under 18, your parent or guardian must read this notice and authorize your registration; you will be asked to confirm this when creating your account.
[PENDING: minimum age and consent verification method defined by the legal team].

sections.title: Purposes
items: Necessary: create and manage your account, save your progress, show your tree, the leaderboard and family mode, and provide support.
The public leaderboard shows your first name, house, avatar and points; in family mode, members of your family see your name, avatar, house and progress.
[PENDING: secondary purposes (e.g., statistics or communications) and how to opt out].

sections.title: What is stored on your phone
items: Xafari does not use cookies. It uses the browser's local storage (localStorage) to keep your session, basic profile data, language, sound settings and any progress not yet sent while offline.
Logging out removes the session and your profile data from that phone. You can also clear them in your browser settings.

sections.title: Where data is stored and transfers
items: The app is hosted by Vercel Inc. and the server and database by Render Services, Inc., both in the United States, acting as processors on behalf of the controller.

sections.title: Security
items: The connection to the server uses HTTPS and passwords are stored with a hashing algorithm, not in readable text.
Only you can see and change your account data while logged in.

sections.title: Your rights (ARCO) and withdrawal of consent
items: You can access, rectify, cancel or object to the use of your data, and withdraw your consent.

terms.title: Xafari Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Xafari app and outline the basic rules to enjoy the adventure safely and respectfully.
accountList: Provide real information so your avatar and progress reflect your experience.
You are responsible for keeping your login and device secure.
If you notice unauthorised use, let us know immediately so we can protect your account.
playList: Missions are narrative: they do not require dangerous or invasive actions.
Respect safety signs and follow staff instructions in any physical spaces.
Progress may be reset if misuse or cheating is detected.
conductList: Respect fellow players and collaborators; avoid offensive or discriminatory language.
Do not share content that infringes copyrights or others' privacy.
Follow the rules of each location you visit in and out of the game.
dataList: We use your data according to the Privacy Notice; you can consult it anytime from the menu.
Some missions may send notifications; adjust permissions on your device if you prefer.
We store your progress to sync it across sessions and devices.
terms.supportDescription: For questions or requests, email support@xafari.com and include your user and device.
